query:
SELECT s.nome as setor, 
       COUNT(DISTINCT pdi.parteDiariaId) as partes_com_setor,
       SUM(pdi.producao) as producao_total,
       SUM(pdi.quantidade) as qtd_total
FROM parte_diaria_itens pdi
JOIN parte_diaria pd ON pdi.parteDiariaId = pd.id
JOIN setores s ON pdi.setorId = s.id
WHERE pd.data >= '2026-04-01' AND pd.data < '2026-05-01'
GROUP BY s.id, s.nome
ORDER BY producao_total DESC;
